text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki has taken the crowd with her

mesmerizing performance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When the curtains close on the NHK
Mile Cup,
the audience comes alive with
conversation, their
hearts completely
taken by the miracle they just
witnessed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! The crowd's so much more fired
up than I
expected them to be! Thank
goodness!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
See, I told you! You should never
underestimate
Fuji's ability to charm
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"So long as we shine, any race we run
can be the
best one ever," huh?

text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I can watch how she does for a
little
longer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew! It looks like everyone had a good
time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: More importantly, she came, and she looked pretty pleased. That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But it's still not enough to fully open the
path I
want to follow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What I'm going for is a path full of
powerful
emotions!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want a path brimming with competition
so fierce
it'll take people's breath away,
with twists and
turns that will shock all
and a heart-pounding
climax!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Our next race is the Mile Championship,
right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship is where the
autumn
queen of the mile is
crowned—even senior racers
participate.
Skipping it isn't an option for those
on
the mile tour.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The best sprinters and milers will be
there—it's
going to be incredible.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And it won't make for a fun race if I'm no
match
for them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I promised to open a path for others. So
let's get
even stronger this summer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next race on our schedule is
the Mile
Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our race through the summer toward the
Mile
Championship and the strong
opponents waiting
there begins now!
